signal: Mechanical Orchard launched its end-to-end mainframe modernization platform Imogen in April 2025 with first partner Thoughtworks, on the back of a $50M GV-led round.

email.subject1: a signal play for Mechanical Orchard
email.body1:
Alex, saw Mechanical Orchard launched Imogen and kicked off your Thoughtworks partnership.

A platform launch into a market where 71% of the Fortune 500 still run mainframes usually means more in-market accounts than a strategic sales team can cover, and that is where deals slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Mechanical Orchard off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Alex, quick follow-up for Mechanical Orchard.

With Imogen live and GV backing, the pipeline target usually climbs faster than headcount can. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit it, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show how many meetings Mechanical Orchard needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Alex, last bit of proof for Mechanical Orchard.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Mechanical Orchard's reply rate likely compares to other enterprise platform teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Alex, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Right after a platform launch, coverage is hard to get to, and I know timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your strategic sales motion? I'll tailor it to Mechanical Orchard either way.
